植物功能基因挖掘与多维证据分析平台: An Integrated Platform for Plant Gene Discovery and Multi-dimensional Evidence Analysis
面向植物功能基因挖掘的多维证据分析与候选基因优选平台: Plant gene discovery and multi-dimensional evidence analysis
管理植物序列、审查 BLAST 命中并记录可复查的筛选参数。: Manage plant sequences, review BLAST hits and record reproducible filtering parameters.
游客分析不会自动长期保存，请及时下载结果。: Guest analyses are temporary. Download your results before leaving.
示例序列为人工生成，命中表包含 60 条模拟记录。可下载文件，或在对应页面直接载: The synthetic example has 60 simulated hits. Download the files or load them from the analysis pages.
请载入 FASTA 文件并明确选择序列类型。: Load a FASTA file and select its sequence type.
请检查表中标记的重复 ID、非法字符和空序列。: Review duplicate IDs, invalid characters and empty sequences marked in the table.
GC 使用 Biopython 的模糊碱基排除规则，S 与 W 按已知 GC 类: GC uses Biopython ambiguity handling. S and W are counted in their known GC categories. Unavailable values are blank.
文件超过 10 MB，请拆分后再上传。: The file exceeds 10 MB. Split it before uploading.
请上传 BLAST 表格或载入模拟教学数据。: Upload a BLAST table or load demonstration data.
一致性 pident 表示比对区段中相同位置的百分比；比特得分 bitscore: pident is the percentage of matching positions. A higher bitscore usually indicates a higher-scoring alignment.
预设用于快速试筛，阈值可调整，应结合物种、基因家族和研究目标解释。: Presets are starting points. Interpret thresholds for your species, gene family and research objective.
qcovs 为每个 Subject 的查询序列总体覆盖度，qcovhsp 为单个: qcovs covers all alignments for a subject and qcovhsp covers one HSP. Missing coverage fails an active coverage filter.
本表没有可用的 Query coverage 数值。: This table has no usable query coverage.
当前阈值下没有保留的命中。: No hits pass the current thresholds.
点击表头按任一指标排序。E-value 按原始文本保留；可用下拉列表按数值排序。: Select a column header to sort, or use the dropdown to sort E-values numerically.
同一 Query 按 Bit score 降序、E-value 升序、Ident: Rank by descending bitscore, ascending E-value, descending identity and length, then subject ID and input order.
对每个 Query 统计筛选后唯一的 Subject ID，保留候选数为 0 的: Count unique retained subjects per query, including queries with zero hits.
请先在 BLAST 候选筛选页载入表格并完成筛选。: Load and filter a table on the BLAST hit screening page first.
当前没有保留的命中可用于分布图。: No retained hits are available for distribution charts.
当前命中没有可用于绘图的覆盖度。: The retained hits have no coverage values to plot.
Word 报告生成失败。若选了图表，请检查 Kaleido 与 Chromium: Word generation failed. If charts were selected, check Kaleido and Chromium or retry without them.
轻量预览支持 Word 文字与表格。带图报告请使用本地或 Docker 版本。: The lightweight preview exports Word text and tables. Use the local or Docker version for embedded images.
访问 FASTA 或结果可视化页面后，可在此选择已生成的图表。: Generate charts on the FASTA or Visualizations page to select them here.
面向植物生物信息学，为教学和科研提供可复查的候选基因筛选、数据可视化与结果交流工: Reproducible candidate screening, visualization and reporting for teaching and plant bioinformatics research.
适合植物科学专业本科生、研究生、生物信息学初学者及科研人员。: For students, researchers and teams working in plant science and bioinformatics.
上传数据 → 检查数据 → 设置参数 → 执行分析 → 查看结果 → 导出文件: Upload → Validate → Configure → Analyze → Review → Export
上传内容及分析结果仅在当前会话中处理。模拟教学数据不用于真实生物学推断。多维证据: Guest data is temporary. Demonstration data cannot support biological inference. Integrated evidence scoring and BLAST+ database search are planned.
使用 Biopython 对两条序列进行全局或局部比对。数据库同源搜索需要独立的: Use Biopython for global or local alignment of two sequences. Database homology search is a separate BLAST workflow.
一致性 = 匹配列数 / 全部比对列数，含 gap。: Identity includes gap columns in the denominator.
没有找到正分的局部比对。: No positive-score local alignment was found.
比对 FASTA 不能超过 5 MB。: Alignment FASTA is limited to 5 MB.
请上传至少包含两条序列的 FASTA。: Upload a FASTA file with at least two sequences.
选择 PNG 或 SVG 后，点击图表工具栏的相机图标下载。: Select PNG or SVG, then click the camera icon in the plot toolbar to download.
静态图生成失败。请确认 Kaleido 和 Chrome/Chromium 可正: Image generation failed. Check the Kaleido and Chrome/Chromium installation.
每条记录从 > 和序列 ID 开始，随后为核酸或蛋白质序列。导入时请选择类型。: Each record starts with > and an identifier, followed by nucleotide or protein sequence. Select the type when importing.
pident 是序列一致性百分比，bitscore 是比特得分，E-value: pident is percent identity, bitscore is a standardized score, E-value estimates chance hits and qcovs is query coverage per subject.
先查看字段映射，再调整一致性、E-value、长度和覆盖度。成对比对、数据库搜索: Confirm field mapping before adjusting identity, E-value, length or coverage. Alignment, database search and filtering are separate operations.
编辑样式后使用图表工具栏或图片导出。打开分析记录页面，选择报告语言、图表和结果表: Edit the chart style before exporting. In Records and exports, select the report language, charts and tables.
游客可以直接分析。项目保存需要登录和可用的持久化服务。退出前请确认保存成功。: Guests can analyze data immediately. Saving projects requires sign-in and a configured persistent service.
覆盖度缺失时不要当作 0%。相似性证据无法单独确认基因功能。恢复项目时请确认是否: Missing coverage is different from zero coverage. Similarity alone cannot confirm gene function. Opening a saved project replaces the active workspace.
账户服务尚未配置。游客仍可运行分析和导出文件。: Account service is not configured. Guests can still analyze and export files.
开发账户模式。请勿在公共部署中启用。: Development account mode. Do not enable it on a public deployment.
确认永久删除账户和项目: Confirm permanent deletion of your account and projects
开发模式不发送密码重置邮件。: Development mode does not send password-reset email.
请查收确认邮件，然后登录。: Check your confirmation email, then sign in.
如账户可用，请查看重置邮件。: If the account is eligible, check your inbox for reset instructions.
登录后可保存当前分析。登录过程会保留游客分析。: Sign in to save your current analysis. Guest analyses are retained during sign-in.
打开项目将替换当前分析: Opening this project replaces the current analysis
确认永久删除所选项目: Confirm permanent deletion of this project
将当前分析另存为新项目: Save current analysis as a new project
每两分钟自动保存已创建的项目: Auto-save an existing project every two minutes
操作失败，请稍后重试。: The operation failed. Try again later.
会话已失效，请重新登录。: Your session expired. Sign in again.
电子邮箱无效，或密码长度不在 12–256 字符范围内。: Enter a valid email and a password of 12–256 characters.
项目名称不能为空，元数据每项不得超过 200 字符。: Provide a project name. Each metadata field is limited to 200 characters.
项目超过 32 MB 保存上限。请拆分数据后重试。: The project exceeds the 32 MB limit. Split the data and try again.
服务未完成请求，请检查输入或稍后重试。: The service could not complete the request. Check your inputs or try again later.
暂时无法连接账户或项目服务。: Could not connect to the account or project service.
BLAST 命中仅提供序列相似性证据。基因功能和直系同源关系需要独立验证。: BLAST hits provide evidence of sequence similarity. Gene function and orthology require independent validation.
表格与结果受当前阈值影响。: Tables and results reflect the current thresholds.
设置阈值并查看最佳命中: Set thresholds and inspect best hits
请选择核酸或蛋白质序列类型。: Select nucleotide or protein sequence type.
请输入有效的非负 E-value，支持科学计数法。: Enter a valid nonnegative E-value. Scientific notation is supported.
BLAST 文件没有可读取的表格数据。: This BLAST file has no readable tabular data.
BLAST 表格至少需要 6 列，请检查分隔符。: A BLAST table needs at least six columns. Check the delimiter.
BLAST 表格只有表头，没有命中记录。: The BLAST file has a header and no hits.
检查序列、统计长度和核酸 GC 含量。: Validate sequences and summarize length and nucleotide GC.
映射字段、设置阈值并比较候选命中。: Map columns, set thresholds and compare candidate hits.
对两条核酸或蛋白质序列执行全局或局部比对。: Run global or local alignment of two nucleotide or protein sequences.
比较分布、覆盖度与各 Query 的候选数量。: Compare distributions, coverage and candidate counts.
编辑 Plotly 样式并下载图像、HTML、CSV 或 JSON 配置。: Style Plotly charts and export images, HTML, CSV or JSON configuration.
导出可复查的参数、候选表和带图的 Word 报告。: Export reproducible parameters, candidate tables and Word reports.
植物序列分析与候选基因筛选平台: Plant sequence analysis and candidate screening
柱形统计 BLAST 命中记录。一个 Subject 可对应多条记录。: Bars count BLAST hit records. A subject may occur in multiple records.
可从 Excel 复制多行两列，粘贴到表格中。也可使用下方文本入口。: Paste rows from Excel into the grid or use the text import below.
每行格式：序列编号、Tab、序列内容: Each row: sequence ID, Tab, sequence
请粘贴最多 5,000 行的两列表格。: Paste a two-column table with at most 5,000 rows.
FASTA 分析不会产生 BLAST 命中。请提供外部 BLAST 结果文件。: FASTA analysis does not produce BLAST hits. Supply results from an external BLAST run.
下一阶段可导入已有 BLAST 比对结果，进行候选筛选。: Import existing BLAST results to screen candidates in the next stage.
仅显示前 N 个类别: Show only the first N categories
模拟教学数据，不代表真实科研结果。: Simulated teaching data. These files are not research results.
用于 FASTA 序列分析。打开 FASTA 页上传 .fasta 文件。: Upload the .fasta file to the FASTA Analysis page.
用于导入与筛选示例。打开 BLAST 候选筛选页上传 .tsv 文件。: Upload the .tsv file to the BLAST Screening page to practice importing hits.
